faq.q: Is Willoughby the same as Willoughby Heights?
faq.a: The Township's planning name is Willoughby; the board's sub-area name — the name on every card on this page — is Willoughby Heights (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/batch-2/willoughby-heights.md, read 2026-11-01).

faq.q: How did Willoughby Heights sell in September 2026?
faq.a: Detached: 100 listings, 13 sold, 13% sales ratio. Condos & Townhomes: 369 listings, 70 sold, 19% — the largest attached inventory and the largest attached sales count of any Langley sub-area that month. No Willoughby-only median is published; the combined Langley medians (detached $1,345,000; attached $611,000) blend in the City of Langley and the other Township sub-areas and are not Willoughby figures (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: What is a coach house in the Township of Langley?
faq.a: Bylaw No. 2500, s.102 defines a coach house as an accessory dwelling unit located only within the second storey of a detached garage on a lot.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in Willoughby?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.

faq.q: Can I add a suite or coach house to a house in Willoughby?
faq.a: BC's small-scale multi-unit housing rules allow more homes on many urban lots, but each municipality sets the details and many lots are excluded. Check the lot's zoning with the municipality before you plan a suite or coach house.
